comment: * Holds information about a window in a {@link Timeline}. A window usually corresponds to one * playlist item and defines a region of media currently available for playback along with * additional information such as whether seeking is supported within the window. The figure below * shows some of the information defined by a window, as well as how this information relates to * corresponding {@link Period Periods} in the timeline. * *

variables.name: SINGLE_WINDOW_UID
variables.comment: * A {@link #uid} for a window that must be used for single-window {@link Timeline Timelines}.

variables.name: uid
variables.comment:
* A unique identifier for the window. Single-window {@link Timeline Timelines} must use {@link
     * #SINGLE_WINDOW_UID}.

variables.name: mediaItem
variables.comment: The {@link MediaItem} associated to the window. Not necessarily unique.

variables.name: manifest
variables.comment: The manifest of the window. May be {@code null}.

variables.name: presentationStartTimeMs
variables.comment:
* The start time of the presentation to which this window belongs in milliseconds since the
     * Unix epoch, or {@link C#TIME_UNSET} if unknown or not applicable. For informational purposes
     * only.

variables.name: windowStartTimeMs
variables.comment:
* The window's start time in milliseconds since the Unix epoch, or {@link C#TIME_UNSET} if
     * unknown or not applicable.

variables.name: elapsedRealtimeEpochOffsetMs
variables.comment:
* The offset between {@link SystemClock#elapsedRealtime()} and the time since the Unix epoch * according to the clock of the media origin server, or {@link C#TIME_UNSET} if unknown or not * applicable. * *

Note that the current Unix time can be retrieved using {@link #getCurrentUnixTimeMs()} and * is calculated as {@code SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() + elapsedRealtimeEpochOffsetMs}.

variables.name: isSeekable
variables.comment: Whether it's possible to seek within this window.

variables.name: isDynamic
variables.comment: Whether this window may change when the timeline is updated.

variables.name: liveConfiguration
variables.comment:
* The {@link MediaItem.LiveConfiguration} that is used or null if {@link #isLive()} returns
     * false.

variables.name: isPlaceholder
variables.comment:
* Whether this window contains placeholder information because the real information has yet to
     * be loaded.

variables.name: defaultPositionUs
variables.comment:
* The default position relative to the start of the window at which to begin playback, in
     * microseconds. May be {@link C#TIME_UNSET} if and only if the window was populated with a
     * non-zero default position projection, and if the specified projection cannot be performed
     * whilst remaining within the bounds of the window.

variables.name: durationUs
variables.comment: The duration of this window in microseconds, or {@link C#TIME_UNSET} if unknown.

variables.name: firstPeriodIndex
variables.comment: The index of the first period that belongs to this window.

variables.name: lastPeriodIndex
variables.comment: The index of the last period that belongs to this window.

variables.name: positionInFirstPeriodUs
variables.comment:
* The position of the start of this window relative to the start of the first period belonging
     * to it, in microseconds.

variables.name: CREATOR
variables.comment:
* Object that can restore {@link Period} from a {@link Bundle}. * *

The {@link #uid} of a restored instance will be a fake {@link Object} and the {@link * #manifest} of the instance will be {@code null}.

methods.name: public Window set(Object uid, @Nullable MediaItem mediaItem, @Nullable Object manifest, long presentationStartTimeMs, long windowStartTimeMs, long elapsedRealtimeEpochOffsetMs, boolean isSeekable, boolean isDynamic, @Nullable MediaItem.LiveConfiguration liveConfiguration, long defaultPositionUs, long durationUs, int firstPeriodIndex, int lastPeriodIndex, long positionInFirstPeriodUs)
methods.comment: Sets the data held by this window.

methods.name: public long getDefaultPositionMs()
methods.comment:
* Returns the default position relative to the start of the window at which to begin playback,
     * in milliseconds. May be {@link C#TIME_UNSET} if and only if the window was populated with a
     * non-zero default position projection, and if the specified projection cannot be performed
     * whilst remaining within the bounds of the window.

methods.name: public long getDefaultPositionUs()
methods.comment:
* Returns the default position relative to the start of the window at which to begin playback,
     * in microseconds. May be {@link C#TIME_UNSET} if and only if the window was populated with a
     * non-zero default position projection, and if the specified projection cannot be performed
     * whilst remaining within the bounds of the window.

methods.name: public long getDurationMs()
methods.comment: Returns the duration of the window in milliseconds, or {@link C#TIME_UNSET} if unknown.

methods.name: public long getDurationUs()
methods.comment: Returns the duration of this window in microseconds, or {@link C#TIME_UNSET} if unknown.

methods.name: public long getPositionInFirstPeriodMs()
methods.comment:
* Returns the position of the start of this window relative to the start of the first period
     * belonging to it, in milliseconds.

methods.name: public long getPositionInFirstPeriodUs()
methods.comment:
* Returns the position of the start of this window relative to the start of the first period
     * belonging to it, in microseconds.

methods.name: public long getCurrentUnixTimeMs()
methods.comment:
* Returns the current time in milliseconds since the Unix epoch. * *

This method applies {@link #elapsedRealtimeEpochOffsetMs known corrections} made available * by the media such that this time corresponds to the clock of the media origin server.

methods.comment: Verifies whether the deprecated isLive member field is in a correct state.
